lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Three levels of piano. Easy... medium... and hard. Let's see how far he gets.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Level one. Easy. Ode to Joy, by Beethoven. The right hand plays the melody, and the left hand just keeps time.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Level two. Medium. Für Elise, also by Beethoven. Now both hands are moving, and the melody gets a lot faster.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Level three. Hard. The Maple Leaf Rag, by Scott Joplin. A jumping left hand, a syncopated right hand, and almost no time to breathe.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He made it through all three levels. Which level are you on? Tell me in the comments.
